name: M365Gov-DataSource-Silence
displayName: M365 Governance - Required Data Source Silence

authoritativeControlOwner.name: Microsoft Sentinel operations for connector health; source products own telemetry
authoritativeControlOwner.sentinelRole: Detects ingestion silence and stale data only.

limitations: UnavailableOrSilent can mean absent, unauthorized, unlicensed, disabled, or no events.
A stale source may be normal for a quiet tenant.
This analytic reports health only and does not infer misconduct or risk.

missingSourceBehavior.description: Missing required sources produce a low-severity operational incident with native remediation routing.

severityRationale: Low because source silence is an operational and coverage condition, not a security verdict.
falsePositiveGuidance: Confirm event volume, licensing, permissions, connector state, table plan, and source latency before treating silence as a fault.
testQuery: Evaluate a documented required source with no records in the 24-hour test window and verify it is labeled UnavailableOrSilent.
